panels.title: Live snapshot -- $camera
panels.description: Captured on request, not continuously -- bytes are only (re-)fetched on dashboard load and when you click Grafana's refresh button (dashboard auto-refresh is intentionally left off). The ?t=${__to} query param is a cache-buster, not a real parameter the backend reads -- without it the src string never changes between refreshes, so neither Grafana's panel re-render nor the browser would have any reason to issue a new request at all (a stale image would keep displaying with no error, since this is independent of HTTP cache headers). ${__to} is Grafana's built-in time-range-end variable, which updates on every manual refresh and page load. Routed through the nginx gateway (same origin as this dashboard page, not a direct Swarm-internal hostname -- a browser can't resolve those). See docs/prometheus_grafana_monitoring_plan.md §4.

panels.title: Reconnect attempts (counts, 2m)
panels.description: A fast-climbing count here is the early-warning signal that was missing before the jaeil_cr fd-leak crash.

panels.title: Last-frame age (seconds)
panels.description: A rising, non-resetting age means this camera stopped producing frames -- a stronger staleness signal than 'thread alive'.
